name: Spinach & Yogurt Chicken Skillet
steps: Sear chicken breast with garlic and olive oil, 6-7 min per side.
Wilt the baby spinach in the same pan.
Off the heat, stir in greek yogurt and lemon juice for a creamy sauce.
Serve over basmati rice.

name: Tomato Spinach Egg Skillet
steps: Simmer cherry tomatoes and garlic until saucy.
Wilt spinach, crack in the eggs, cover 5-6 min.
Top with cheddar and serve.

name: Chickpea Spinach Curry + Rice
steps: Bloom garlic in olive oil, add chickpeas and curry spices.
Simmer 15 min, wilt spinach through at the end.
Serve over basmati rice with a yogurt dollop.

name: Cheesy Garlic Pasta with Peas
steps: Boil pasta, add frozen peas in the last 3 min.
Make a quick cheese sauce with milk, cheddar and garlic.
Toss together.

name: Sheet-Pan Salmon & Roast Veg
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Chop peppers and carrots, toss in olive oil.
Roast veg 15 min, add salmon, roast 12 more.
Finish with lemon.

name: Smashed Avocado Eggs
steps: Smash avocado with lemon, garlic and salt.
Top with jammy 7-minute eggs.
Chili flakes if you have them.

name: Garlic Shrimp Pasta
steps: Sear shrimp 2 min per side, set aside.
Sauce: tomatoes, garlic, splash of pasta water.
Toss pasta, shrimp and spinach together.
